Live it up in Uz! For it won't be long before you drink this cup, too. You'll find out what it's like to drink God's wrath, Get drunk on God's wrath and wake up with nothing, stripped naked.
You won't have to go through this exile again. But Edom, your time is coming: He'll punish your evil life, put all your sins on display.
